_comment: Hook registrations for the five hardened guardrails shipped in this project's hooks/ dir. Merge the "hooks" block below into your Claude Code settings.json (project .claude/settings.json or the user-level ~/.claude/settings.json). $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR resolves to the project root at runtime, so the paths stay generic and portable. PreToolUse guardrails: protect-raw-data blocks edits/overwrites of existing data/raw/ files (adding new raw files is allowed), no-fabricated-exhibit blocks fabricated figure/table scripts (on Edit/Write and on Bash-run scripts), no-offbook-exhibit blocks drawing a figure/table inline in a shell. PostToolUse guardrails: deck-from-pipeline blocks decking an exhibit no wired script produces, no-stale-canon warns when a stage's canon-closure line references an exhibit that isn't right-and-live.
